title: How the build's sessions are organized: a coordinator per repo
why: Orchestrator, Oct 28 14:58 CDT: you proposed three tiers (coordinator, lane leads, triage, all Opus); an Opus blind review with web research says the shape is sound but the cut is wrong.
note: Home for the rulings: docs/decisions/session-tiers.md on main (PR #788, batch 14 #789, main f6cee835; the plan file is cut). Summary: one coordinator per repo; triage always a standing session; a batch runner as a third standing role (shiv's word "branch manager"), the three started together by the coordinator before any lane; triage and the batch runner rotate before they go stale, started by the coordinator itself and archived only after draining (coordinator succession dropped, Oct 28 15:24); a session pushes back in one line when work reaches the wrong tier; shape is picked from the request (solo, one lane, coordinator). Rulings, Oct 28 16:15 CDT (shiv, waiting page): item 50 b, lane sessions run Opus (they keep themselves light but need top reasoning on what they are asked); item 53 a, test the cloud route for a per-tier context limit (his step, item 58, done Oct 28 17:46 CDT: he says the variable works in an experimental cloud session he made; unverified by a session of ours until the coordinator starts a lane there and reads its limit). Ruling, Oct 28 17:50 CDT (shiv, item 59, a): keep today's helper-agent model and effort table until lane L1 measures cost and quality. Open: whether he answers triage directly more often. Lanes L1 (rules, glossary), L2 (skills), L3 (session-start guard) start after batch 13 merges. Placed after c200 (triage 12, Oct 28). Item 58 test, measured Oct 28 17:53 CDT (coordinator, get_session): a lane session (c203, session_013NEJL4Ghu7Kthvr3kBsiVR) in shiv's environment "lane test" reports context_usage max_tokens 200000, while the repo default reads 500000. So a per-environment context window works for a cloud lane. Not in the record yet (for lane L1 to add): the 15:04 ask to revise the solo-versus-orchestrate rules to match the tiers (and his Opus review), and the measured fact that get_session on a child returns external_metadata.context_usage {used_tokens, max_tokens} and autocompact_state {threshold, effective_window} (q_max lane read 171216 of 500000, threshold 384000; the lane-test lane read max_tokens 200000), so the coordinator reads each standing session's tally itself. Lane L2 (skills): draft #794, head 85e563e0, accepted Oct 28 19:28 CDT; joins batch 16. Tag convention settled: cs-repo:<owner>/<name> plus cs-build:<tier>. Lane L3 (session-start guard) stopped at design, Oct 28 18:40 CDT (its outbox note): a hook cannot reach the session list (get_session and list_sessions are model-only tools; the hook-side route, the sessions API with the container's ingress token, is the workaround its brief bars). The parent id and tier live in the session record only (parent_session_id, the cs-build:<tier> tag). Design A: session_start.sh prints one fixed line chosen by an env flag, telling a child to call get_session and a top session to pick a shape and, before acting as coordinator, to look for a live cs-build:coordinator row for its repo (cost: one env read in the running hook; needs proof that hooks get CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION). Design B: the same lines as rule text in CLAUDE.md, no hook. Deferred: whether A is in scope or a workaround is the coordinator's call. Batch 17 #796 (main 134b23ca), Oct 28 22:45 CDT: L2 (session tiers in skills, #794) merged. L1 (rules, glossary) and L3 (session-start line) are still running, so the step stays todo. Batch 18 #798 (main 1cc47f01), Oct 29 11:38 CDT: L1 (session tiers in rules and glossary, #797) merged. Only L3 (session-start line) is left. Item 59 a (measure helper-agent cost and quality) is queued, unstarted; L1's brief did not carry it. Item 67 (opus-grants-reach-lanes, coordinator, Oct 29 13:43 CDT): how your Opus grant reaches a lane; (a) record on the step and the lane's guard reads it (recommended), (b) you type it in each lane, (c) a brief's claim is accepted (against uniform ruling t18). Open.
